sources.description: It’s been a few short days since the Broncos pulled out a win over a hapless Chargers team, and in less than 24 hours, they will be trying to do it again. Except this time, the opponent is the defending Super Bowl champs with its revitalized journeyman quarterback throwing to last season’s Offensive Player of […]
